# Styx — The MCP-Native AI Gateway

> Route requests to any AI provider through one universal endpoint. Self-hosted. Open source. BYOK.

Styx is an open-source AI gateway and MCP server that sits between your app and AI providers. Send requests to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Mistral through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Bring your own API keys, self-host on your infrastructure, and get full visibility into every request. Apache 2.0 licensed.

## Quick Start

Self-host in 5 minutes:
```
git clone https://github.com/timmx7/styx.git
cd styx
cp .env.example .env
docker compose up -d
```

Or use the REST API (OpenAI SDK compatible):
```python
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(api_key="your-styx-key", base_url="http://localhost:8080/v1")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello from Styx!"}]
)
```

## MCP Integration

Connect Claude Code:
```
claude mcp add styx -- npx styx-mcp
```

Connect Cursor (add to .cursor/mcp.json):
```json
{
  "styx": {
    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["styx-mcp"],
    "env": { "STYX_API_KEY": "your-key" }
  }
}
```

## Key Features

- MCP-native: first AI gateway built for the Model Context Protocol
- Multi-provider: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral through one endpoint
- BYOK: bring your own API keys, encrypted at rest with Fernet (AES)
- Semantic caching: vector similarity search avoids paying twice for similar queries
- Smart routing: ML classifier routes requests to the optimal model
- Automatic failover: circuit breaker with zero-downtime provider switching
- Dashboard: track requests, costs, latency per project and model
- Billing: built-in Stripe subscription and credit-based billing
- Self-hosted: Docker Compose, full control over your data
- Secure: HMAC key hashing, rate limiting, TLS, HSTS, CSP

## Supported Providers

- OpenAI: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, o1, o3
- Anthropic: Claude Opus 4, Claude Sonnet 4, Claude 3.5
- Google: Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Pro
- Mistral: Mistral Large, Mistral Small

## Architecture

- Go reverse proxy (router) — <10ms overhead, circuit breakers, health checks
- Python FastAPI backend — auth, billing, business logic
- Next.js dashboard — real-time analytics, project management
- PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, Qdrant — data layer
